name: mooncode-agent
description: MoonCode Agent and local MCP Bridge

mooncode.bridge.tunnel.authMode.description: Bridge authentication mode. Personal/Quick connections default to a high-entropy capability URL; OAuth remains available for long-lived or managed connections.

mooncode.bridge.tunnel.browserOriginMode.description: Browser CORS policy for Remote MCP. universal_https reflects any valid HTTPS Origin, known allows built-in verified origins, and custom uses browserOrigins. This never replaces capability/OAuth authentication or local permissions.

mooncode.bridge.tunnel.browserOrigins.description: Custom HTTPS browser origins used only when browserOriginMode=custom. Use origins only, with no path/query/fragment.

mooncode.bridge.tunnel.provider.description: Public transport provider. Authentication is selected independently by mooncode.bridge.tunnel.authMode.

mooncode.bridge.tunnel.publicUrl.description: Stable HTTPS origin for Cloudflare Named or ngrok, for example https://bridge.example.com.

mooncode.bridge.tunnel.proxyUrl.description: Optional HTTP/HTTPS proxy URL passed only to the tunnel helper environment.

mooncode.bridge.tunnel.startupTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time for tunnel startup and public health validation.

mooncode.bridge.tunnel.localPort.description: Local Bridge port used by Cloudflare Named remote ingress. Quick/ngrok normally use an automatic port.

mooncode.bridge.tunnel.persistentMode.description: Restart the saved Bridge transport on MoonCode startup. Automatic write/exec permission is never restored.

mooncode.bridge.tunnel.quickLinks.description: Show connection shortcuts in the Bridge UI when available.

mooncode.bridge.oauth.issuer.description: OAuth authorization server issuer used to validate Bridge access tokens.

mooncode.bridge.oauth.jwksUri.description: JWKS endpoint for Bridge token verification.

mooncode.bridge.oauth.resourceId.description: Stable MoonCode Bridge resource/device binding identifier.

mooncode.bridge.oauth.endpointGeneration.description: Current endpoint generation bound into Bridge access tokens.

mooncode.bridge.oauth.resource.description: Optional explicit public MCP resource URL. Normally derived for Named/ngrok and discovered after Quick Tunnel publication.

mooncode.cloud.apiUrl.description: Development/diagnostic override for the MoonCode Cloud API origin. Production installers embed the Cloud origin in product.json; ordinary users should not need to set this. HTTPS is required except localhost development. Account sessions are stored only in SecretStorage.
